Threads the session store into createMessageHandler and answers
list_sessions beside ping: listFor runs for the session's own user,
summaries serialise to ISO strings, and a rejecting store logs on the
ws category and answers SERVER_ERROR while the socket stays open.
Frames off the lock join a per-socket chain, so a burst of frames is
answered in arrival order and a pong cannot overtake a list answer.

Deduplicates the socket suites' shared harness into wsTestSupport
(eventually, the drained teardown, delegatingTo) and fixes the three
lint findings in the new suites. Spec anchors repointed to the moved
tests.
